column1: # Homebrew candidates and version floors, with exact Pixi fallback pins in
# common-tools.tsv. Compatible device commands are adopted first.
# installer homebrew: adopted from the device, never installed here.
# kind formula|cask: the installer's own package kind.
# minimum: the lowest installed version the deployment accepts.
# bundle: common, or the optional tool bundle that selects this row.
# platforms: comma-separated platform names, or all.
# Common command groups. Names match common-tools.tsv environments. Their
# exact Pixi specifications remain the fallback when adoption is unavailable.
